title: When the Language Burns
author: Mirabel Ishikawa
blurb: Ivo Whitlock, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
